description:
Scholarship overview

Otago's Doctoral Scholarship supports selected research students with a living stipend and domestic-rate tuition. Applications can be submitted through the doctoral process, with decisions made in quarterly consideration rounds rather than on one annual deadline.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Otago doctoral subjects
  • Research training
  • Doctoral study

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 34,128/year plus domestic tuition
DurationUp to 36 months

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsUp to 36 months; scholarship and doctoral admission requirements apply.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusRolling applications; quarterly consideration
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026 next quarterly consideration round
LocationNew Zealand

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About University of Otago

Otago offers doctoral research and competitive university scholarships. Applicants follow the university's doctoral admission process, while scholarship decisions are made through scheduled consideration rounds.

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
